responsibility: Declares the processor-independent LynxOS target options -mlegacy-threads, -mshared, and -mthreads. These options feed the Lynx specs in lynx.h to control thread-library selection and default shared-versus-static linking behavior.
same_name_distinction: Within the Lynx same-name pair, this file only declares the LynxOS option switches -mlegacy-threads, -mshared, and -mthreads; lynx.h is the file that turns those switches into actual preprocessing, library-selection, and link/startfile behavior.
